description: Temporary high/critical npm advisory exceptions. Each exception requires a reason and expires; this list may not grow on a PR.

entries.reason: Vite 5.4.21 is transitive through VitePress 1.6.4, which pins vite ^5.4.14, so the fixed 6.4.3+ line is unreachable through that path; only the docs-toolchain vite is in range (vitest's nested vite 8.2.0 is not). Covers GHSA-4w7w-66w2-5vf9 (optimized-deps .map path traversal), GHSA-v6wh-96g9-6wx3 (launch-editor UNC hash disclosure, Windows), and GHSA-fx2h-pf6j-xcff (server.fs.deny bypass on Windows alternate paths) — all reachable only against a running local docs dev server. Expiry deliberately not extended when the third advisory was added: upgrade or remove VitePress before it lapses.

GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr (ICNS parser infinite loop) and GHSA-5p2g-fcmc-qvqq (JXL/HEIF parser infinite loops). No fixed release exists: the advisories cover <=2.0.2 and 2.0.2 is the latest published version, so there is nothing to upgrade to. Reached only as react-native -> @react-native/community-cli-plugin -> metro -> image-size, i.e. Metro's build-time asset pipeline; it never executes on a user device. Exposure is a denial of service against a developer bundling a crafted image from their own source tree. Re-check for an upstream release before expiry.
No advisory of its own; flagged solely for depending on image-size. Clears when image-size does.
